block_size: 1 km = 10 x 10 100-m pixels, aligned to the raster origin
prior: H19-5 positive-support pixels per strictly eligible pixel in each block; fixed before looking at holdout or live results
donor_rule: Ascending-prior occupied blocks sufficient for the 20% dose; one donor per block per pass, raster-order within a block
receiver_rule: Same number of descending-prior blocks as donor blocks; one receiver per block per pass; vacant H19-5 support only, max-min distance from the compliant parent within a block
compliance_rule: Because the brief requires >=3 Euclidean px for non-PRUNE arms while R0 contains 1,611 dots at 2<d<3, relocate those dots before dosing. Preserve block counts where possible, prefer H19-5 support, and disclose all fallback moves. This fixed repair is a confound versus R0, not a concentration effect.
decision_rule: A live change below 0.01 in absolute value is no evidence. Proxy, canary, SGMC, CV, and overlap diagnostics never authorize or rank a submission.
falsifier: A same-arm live decrease of at least 0.01 falsifies the predicted sign; a negative 15% result also falsifies the occupied-block-CV motivation. No result validates private chunks or expert-expanded labels.
